name: Kaleidoscope
summary: A drifting window into the album art or your photos; pair it with a Kaleidoscope effect for mirrors.
hint: A window into the picture drifts and turns with the music; the layer's kaleidoscope effect makes the mirrors. Photos fall back to the album art when the folder is empty.

params.label: Per photo
params.help: With My photos: how long each photo stays.

params.label: Window
params.help: How much of the picture's height the window shows.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far the window tumbles when the song moves to a new section.

params.label: Bar sway
params.help: How much the window breathes in and out once a bar, as much as the beat is sure.
